NOTIFICATION
TRAINED GRADUATE TEACHER EXAMINATION-2026 (SECONDARY LEVEL)
The Commission in its Notification of even no. dated 25th June 2026 had advised all
candidates of Trained Graduate Teacher Examination-2026 (Secondary Level) to download their
Admit cards and verifu its contents, including the concemed subject, and mail any requests for
correction to the helpdesk appsc.i:elpdesk-arn@gov.in on or before I lAM of 30fl' June 2026.
Subsequently, the Commission has also individually mailed all the candidates for
submitting their requests for change in the details of Admit Card, if any.
Now, in view of the representations received from candidates requesting for change in the
details of concerned subject, the Commission has considered their requests and accordingly, the
revised Admit Card reflecting the change in concerned subject will be available for download
w.e.f 6 PM of 02/07126 till 08.30 AM on 12107126. The requests for change in examination
venue/centre have not been accepted.
No further requests for correction in concerned subject will be entertained.
This is issued with the approval of the Commission.
